diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~68% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.088), which favours a robust combination.
